items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check and skirting replacement
items.rationale: The washing-machine hose leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2(a). Section 7.1.7 covers necessary cleaning of affected flooring, checking the source, and replacing damaged skirting like for like; allow €460 gross for the combined work.

Sections 7.1.7(b), (e) and (g) cover necessary moisture checks, dryer hire and labour in both affected spaces. Allow €520 gross for a modest drying job, with no separate utility charge under §7.1.8(d).

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed poster
items.rationale: The mass-produced poster is movable contents excluded by §4.3(d), not an item of particular value under §5.2.6; the €1,000 net limit for unlisted qualifying items does not create cover. If accepted as a qualifying item, a basic assessment and drying would cost about €110 gross.
